Start growing with data-backed decisions.

records.name: stock heart beat
records.tagline: Hype in. Filings out.
records.description: A research desk that reads the morning's filings and the channels you trust, checks every claim against the company's own filed documents, and publishes only what survives.

records.name: Fragment
records.tagline: AI doesn't know your customers. Fragment does!
records.description: Agents made writing code the easy part. The hard part is still figuring out what to build, and keeping your teams, and their agents, on the same page. Fragment turns what your customers say, what your product does, and what your company knows into structured evidence. So you build products that people want.

records.name: Oatmeal
records.tagline: Nutrition tracking you'll actually stick to
records.description: Oatmeal is the #1 AI-powered nutrition tracker. Log meals with text, voice, or photo. Get personalized macro insights, streak tracking, and smart nutrition coaching. Download free on iOS & Android.

records.name: HOUSEKEEPING (USA)
records.tagline: Full-time & Part-time opportunities may be available
records.description: Requirements: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States Reliable and responsible Attention to cleanliness and detail Previous housekeeping experience is a plus Send your resume and application to: [YOUR EMAIL ADDRESS]

records.name: SolarMaxx
records.tagline: Reliable Solar EPC Solutions for Businesses
records.description: Commercial and industrial solar EPC across North India and select international sites. With 600+ rooftop sites and 250+ MW installed, SolarMaxx provides one accountable partner from feasibility to grid connection.

records.name: OneCraft
records.tagline: One prompt, five formats: docs, decks, flyers, forms, video
records.description: Describe what you need and OneCraft designs it. Presentations, flyers, forms, documents, videos and e-signatures, all editable, from one account. Start free.

records.name: ZMF Media
records.tagline: **The Future of Creator Growth Starts Here.**
records.description: ZMF Media is built to help creators turn their ideas into growth. Get AI-powered content insights, personalized strategies, creator tools, and resources designed to help you create smarter, grow your audience, and build your brand.

records.name: YourWall (Beta)
records.tagline: Social media without the algorithm
records.description: YourWall is social media without the algorithm. Follow someone, see everything they post, in order, no ranking system deciding what you're allowed to see. Your data is never sold and never used to train AI. No ads either, YourWall runs on decorative profile cosmetics sold through a shop instead. Built solo by a cybersecurity guy who got tired of missing his friends' posts. In early beta with invite codes to give out, comment below to grab one.

records.name: DSH Plugins
records.tagline: DeepSeek Harness Plugins Directory
records.description: Browse 5000+ DeepSeek Harness plugins and dsh plugins — UI skins, tools, workflows and agents, searchable by category, GitHub stars and recency.

records.name: Ovyero
records.tagline: Tracking and Governance for AI Coders
records.description: Ovyero is a system that Tracks and Logs what your AI is doing in your codebase. It creates persistent context of your project and gives you access to an audit log of what your AI coder does in your codebase. It works at the commit level and is built for teams.

records.name: YouTube Thumbnail Downloader
records.tagline: Application for downloading thumbnails
records.description: Download high-quality YouTube thumbnails in various resolutions instantly. Free and easy to use!

records.name: Caring for Body and Spirit
records.tagline: gifts for elderly women​
records.description: Bring comfort and daily happiness to seniors through curated gifts for elderly women designed specifically to nurture their golden-year lifestyle. View the article here:https://familiro.com/blog/gifts-for-elderly-women

records.name: Caveau — Collection Catalog
records.tagline: AI app that photographs your bookshelf and catalogs book
records.description: I've been building a small tool called Caveau Snap a photo → AI reads every spine and extracts title, author, edition, year Tracks exact position (e.g. "Shelf B, Row 2, 3rd from left") Search across your whole collection instantly Works for books, wine, stamps, model cars, vinyl — anything on a shelf Any feedback appreciated, especially from people who've tried to catalog large collections manually.

records.name: Physics lab
records.tagline: Physics lab
records.description: It is a html file made without a computer so no judgment. It is a physics learning platform form bangali. The file is made fully in bangla. The goal of the file is teach the students basic of the physics

records.name: Image Compressor
records.tagline: Shrink images without losing quality, right in your browser
records.description: Free online image compressor — 100% in-browser, private, no upload, no watermark. Compress & convert JPG/PNG/WebP/AVIF, auto-fit a target size (e.g. 200KB), batch compress and export ZIP.

records.name: Fish Identifier
records.tagline: Identify fish from a photo with AI-assisted visual clues
records.description: Fish Identifier is an AI-assisted online tool that goes beyond a species guess. Upload one clear fish photo to get a likely species, fish type, visible clues, habitat context, possible lookalikes, and a practical next step. It’s a quick first check for anglers, aquarists, travelers, and curious nature lovers.

records.name: Dairy-Free Recipes
records.tagline: 115 dairy-free, plant-based recipes — light & low-cost
records.description: Dairy-Free Recipes is a 28-page PDF cookbook for anyone cooking without milk, butter, or cheese — by choice, allergy, or intolerance. It opens with a short, myth-free chapter on the actual science of lactose intolerance and dairy-free nutrition, then delivers 15 fully developed recipes plus 100 more quick, low-cost, plant-based meals across 10 categories. No specialty ingredients — just real, affordable food.

records.name: Bartools
records.tagline: What cocktails can you make with the bottles you have?
records.description: Bartools is a web app that turns your home bar into a decision engine. Add the bottles you already own, see exactly what cocktails you can make tonight, and discover which ONE more bottle would unlock the most new recipes.

records.name: The Socratic Arena
records.tagline: Train your reasoning through live AI-judged debates
records.description: Train your reasoning through live structured debates, AI-assisted multi-judge feedback, targeted coaching, and Evidence Arena. Debate people or AI, challenge your own PDFs with grounded citations, and build a verifiable reasoning profile over time.

records.name: Kroner
records.tagline: You set it up once, then leave it alone.
records.description: Kroner handles event scheduling, recurring routines, and email automation — everyday work, done quickly with AI, all from one platform.

records.name: Valix
records.tagline: Valix - Daily Marketing Discipline for SaaS Founders
records.description: Valix analyzes your SaaS, builds a custom marketing plan, and pushes daily actions to keep you consistent. Stay disciplined, grow your pipeline, ship your marketing every day.

records.name: Unwait
records.tagline: Fill the wait between prompts with flashcards
records.description: AI coding agents leave you with dozens of 30-second-to-3-minute waits a day, and most of them end in a phone detour that costs 20 minutes. Unwait is a macOS menu bar app that senses when Claude Code or Codex is working and shows one flashcard in the corner: language vocab, dev concepts, or news. The moment your agent finishes or blocks on a permission prompt, one click puts you back in the right terminal. The overlay never steals keyboard focus. No account. 14-day trial, then $1.99/month.

records.name: MARKET DERBY
records.tagline: Bulls vs bears, played out as real football
records.description: Market Derby turns the live BTC/USDT price into a football match. The price climbs and the bulls attack; it drops and the bears counter. Volatility becomes tempo. Nothing is pre-recorded — today's match has never been played before. Watch a 90-minute match with two halves and a final whistle, or an endless one that never stops. A 3D stadium, a live scoreboard, goal replays. Six languages. Free, no sign-up, no wallet, no bets. It's a broadcast, not a financial product.

records.name: SFTPro
records.tagline: Native Mac SFTP client, keyboard-first, $19.43
records.description: We believe in crafting software that is delightful to use. We use our own products and iterate tirelessly until we fall in love with the creation. SFTPro is a native SFTP client built to make your experience delightful: fresh design, native performance, intuitive interface, keyboard-first navigation, security and encryption It's full of features that help you log in, do the work, and log out. All of this for $19.43 one time - updates included.
